name: Porus Vida
description: Porus Vida was a planet located in the Inner Rim and famous for its beauty and its culture. Despite its reputation as a peaceful world of museums, Porus Vida saw conflict throughout its history, including several sieges during the Alsakan Conflicts, and was devastated by the United Warlord Fleets in 12 ABY.
